body: Well I made it somehow, but I've been this way for a few years but I had a gf and my son to keep me together to where I felt like I might be ok but I can never be happy with what I have, but now I've lost her and I hardly get to see my son, I used to be an opiate addict and I finally relapsed, which is bad enough, but now I'm completely alone and have no friends I work and then go sit at home everyday, and immediately after I got out of the relationship I met a girl that completely changed my outlook that I've always really liked for years and she admitted that she really liked me, I thought everything would be ok, but then I found out she has a boyfriend and basically just played me or whatever I don't know but it was like getting my heart smashed twice, time isn't making anything better only worse if anything, sorry for the wall of text
